scientific_integrity: Exact full-depth tail formula and Haar generating law have a direct proof; integer checks corroborate 1228 finite identities, not the universal theorem.
scientific_limitations: Assumes every actual residue root of each polynomial is simple; excludes multiple-root reductions and does not provide a general-prefix discrepancy bound. Classical Hensel lifting and ball-measure facts are used. Historical priority outside inspected sources is uncertain.
title: A root-collision law for joint polynomial valuations and a quadratic covariance trichotomy
